# asc_vpc (Resource)

Manages a VPC through ASC infra-gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_vpc" "example" {
  name = "example-vpc"

  subnets = [{
    name = "bootstrap"
    cidr = "10.0.0.0/25"
    type = "private"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `subnets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Tags applied to the VPC. infra-gateway patches VPC tags in place, so changing them does not replace the VPC. The tags on an inline subnet are part of the replacement-forcing subnets list.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_error` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `urn` (String)
